_comment: Copy to settings.json and fill the empty values. Names in {braces} are derived; {suffix} is generated once by 00-preflight.ps1 and stored in state/outputs.json.
_tenantId: Your PERSONAL Entra tenant ID. Every script stops if the PoC's Azure CLI profile is signed in to any other tenant.

containers._comment: databricksPlatform holds the Unity Catalog metadata cache for the Snowflake foreign catalogs (written by Databricks only).

entra._comment: domain: leave empty to use the tenant's default verified domain (for example contoso123.onmicrosoft.com).
entra._adminGroup: Data admins see every region in Databricks row filters; the signed-in admin is added to it.

foundry._model: gpt-5-mini is in the Free Tier that a new or Visual Studio subscription can start on. Step 45 pins this version (no auto-upgrade). Global Standard bills per token, so the 200K tokens/min capacity costs nothing extra; it leaves room for large Cortex Agent responses.
foundry._connections: Names of the custom-OAuth project connections you create in the Foundry portal (README step F2), one per MCP server.
foundry._snowflakeTokenTypeHeader: Spike S2 switch: true adds X-Snowflake-Authorization-Token-Type: OAUTH to the Snowflake MCP tools.

snowflake._comment: account: the account identifier (orgname-accountname) of the NEW Enterprise trial in Azure East US 2.
snowflake._cortexAgentModel: Leave empty until step 65 (SF4) lists the models; then pin one that Cortex Agents accept (no 'auto'). The PoC uses openai-gpt-5-mini (Azure US cross-region).

databricks._comment: accountId: copy from https://accounts.azuredatabricks.net (top-right user menu) after the workspace exists.
databricks._sku: Pricing tier of the Azure Databricks workspace: trial = Premium features with 14 days of free DBUs, then compute stops until you upgrade the workspace to premium (README step 55); premium = billed from day one.

budget._comment: Alerts only - nothing is suspended or blocked.
